description: PHOENIX – This past weekend, Gov. Katie Hobbs and her running mate, former Mesa Mayor John Giles, visited La Purisima Bakery in Glendale to discuss the impact of Washington’s cost-hiking policies and rallied supporters at the opening of Maryvale’s Copper State Victory coordinated campaign office. Read more below: Telemundo: Gobernadora Hobbs y Giles visitan panadería local León […]

title: ROUNDUP: Katie Hobbs and John Giles Visit Glendale Bakery and Rally Supporters in Maryvale - Katie Hobbs for Governor
